auth.requiredTitle: Sign in to open the archive
auth.requiredBody: Search, upload, and library pages stay behind the session. Settings remain available so you can choose a language and a time zone first.
auth.loginBody: Use the administrator account seeded by the API. This screen does not invent or store a password.
auth.missingAdmin: DEMO_ADMIN_EMAIL and DEMO_ADMIN_PASSWORD are empty. The API skips seeding until both are set on the API process. They are not written by this interface.

search.title: Find a moment in the archive
search.body: Hybrid search is the default. A phrase is searched when you submit it. An empty query browses matching segments instead of ranking them.
search.placeholder: Describe a scene, an activity, or words spoken in a recording

examples.tracked: Tracked vehicles on muddy terrain during a training exercise.
examples.drones: Drones filmed in a training area.
examples.maintenance: Personnel performing maintenance on a vehicle.

search.dateZone: These dates use {zone}. The time zone does not follow the interface language.
search.valuePlaceholder: Type a value and add it
search.candidates: {count, plural, one {# retrieved candidate} many {# retrieved candidates} other {# retrieved candidates}}
search.segments: {count, plural, one {# matching segment} many {# matching segments} other {# matching segments}}
search.assets: {count, plural, one {# asset} many {# assets} other {# assets}}
search.notComplete: Retrieved candidates are the window that was ranked. This is not a complete count of every match in the archive.
search.rerank: A text rerank pass was applied. It does not see pixels.

fusion.backend_rrf: Combined with reciprocal rank fusion in the API after $rankFusion was not used.

warnings.SORT_WINDOW: Date order applies inside the retrieved window. It is not a sort of the whole archive.

search.nearby: {count, plural, one {# nearby match grouped here} many {# nearby matches grouped here} other {# nearby matches grouped here}}
search.languageNote: The interface language does not translate or re-embed source media. Full-text search does not translate the query.
search.browseNote: Empty query: browsing segments that match the filters, with a complete count.

library.title: Media library
library.body: Every asset in this workspace, including items that are still processing.
library.count: {count, plural, one {# matching asset} many {# matching assets} other {# matching assets}}

upload.title: Add media to the archive
upload.body: The browser sends the file to the API. Processing starts only after the file and the job are stored. This page shows progress and stops with an error if the worker is not running.
upload.types: Accepted types: MP4, MOV, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, MP3, WAV, M4A, and TXT.
upload.limit: The API accepts files up to {size}.
upload.titleHint: Leave this empty to use each file name.

capture.user: I will enter the capture date
capture.file: Read the capture date from the file

upload.viewerOnly: Your role can search the archive. Uploading needs an uploader or an administrator.
upload.draftNote: This draft stays in place when you change language or move to another page.

processing.title: Processing
processing.body: Each job records the stage it has reached. A persisted document is not the same as a search index being queryable.
processing.attempt: {count, plural, one {# attempt} many {# attempts} other {# attempts}}
processing.workerDown: The ingestion worker is not running. Start it with the API, or processing stays queued. A missing provider is reported on the job once the worker runs.

collections.title: Collections
collections.body: Collections are a filter on assets. Deleting one is refused while assets still belong to it.
collections.name: Name
collections.viewerOnly: Creating a collection needs an uploader or an administrator.
collections.adminDelete: Deleting a collection needs an administrator.

settings.title: Settings and system health
settings.body: Language, time zone, and theme are kept in this browser. After you sign in, the profile language and time zone replace the local choice.
settings.languageHint: Names are shown in each language. The archive text is not translated.
settings.timeZoneHint: Timestamps are stored in UTC and shown in this zone, whichever interface language you use.
settings.healthBody: Missing credentials stay missing. This page names unavailable capabilities and does not show a hostname or a connection string.
settings.indexingNote: A database write can record indexing state as persisted. That write is not the same as search-index availability. Atlas builds the vector index and the text index on their own schedule. Queryable, below, is the availability signal.
settings.usersBody: Administrators can add people to this workspace. Passwords need at least 10 characters, a letter, and a digit.
settings.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with a letter and a digit.
settings.legacyObjects: Still on the previous object store

asset.noPlayback: Playback is not available for this asset yet.
asset.noTranscript: No transcript is stored for this segment.
asset.deleteConfirm: Delete this asset, its segments, and its stored objects?
asset.embeddingStale: Search text was rewritten from the new metadata. The embedding was not refreshed. Reprocess to embed again.
asset.title: Title

technical.intro: This panel is built from the technical record. It explains which fields Atlas uses. It does not show the full embedding.
technical.indexingExplainer: indexingState records the document write. Persisted means the segment document was saved. It does not mean the vector index or the text index is queryable yet.
technical.embeddingExplainer: Atlas Vector Search ranks this segment with the embedding array. Only a preview is shown.
technical.previewLength: {count, plural, one {# preview value} many {# preview values} other {# preview values}} of {dimensions} dimensions
technical.noEmbedding: No embedding is stored. Semantic search cannot use this segment until a configured embedding provider writes one.
technical.textExplainer: Full-text search matches these strings. It does not translate them, and changing the interface language does not rewrite them.
technical.filterExplainer: Vector search and full-text search both narrow on these fields before ranking.
technical.textStale: Search text was rewritten after the embedding. Vector search can still reflect the older embedding until reprocess.
technical.textFresh: Search text is not marked stale.
technical.shortEvent: Sampled frames can miss an event that is shorter than the gap between frames. Native video is requested first when the clip fits the provider limits.

errors.AUTH_INVALID: The email or password was not accepted.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields need to be corrected.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The service hit an unexpected error.
errors.OBJECT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Media storage is unavailable because the database is not reachable.
errors.OBJECT_STORAGE_FAILED: Media storage could not finish the request.
errors.QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE: The processing queue is not reachable.
errors.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the upload limit.
errors.FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: This file type is not accepted.
errors.FILE_TYPE_MISMATCH: The file contents do not match the file name.
errors.CORRUPT_MEDIA: The file could not be read as media.
errors.DURATION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The recording is longer than the duration limit.
errors.DUPLICATE_ASSET: This file is already in the archive.
errors.TEXT_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: The text file is not valid UTF-8.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: A required provider is not configured.
errors.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: A provider asked us to slow down.
errors.EMBEDDING_DIMENSION_MISMATCH: The embedding length does not match the index.
errors.EMBEDDING_MODEL_MISMATCH: The embedding model does not match the stored segments.
errors.INDEX_NOT_READY: A search index is not ready.
errors.PASSWORD_POLICY: The password does not meet the policy.
errors.LEGACY_OBJECT_STORAGE: This file still points at the previous object store and was not migrated. It was not deleted.
errors.WORKER_NOT_RUNNING: The ingestion worker is not running, so this upload cannot finish.
